description: Use this tool when a company needs to know whether its product catalogue is READY for the EU Digital Product Passport (DPP/ESPR): pass an array of products (any reasonable JSON shape: name, sku, description, brand, composition/material, country of origin, supplier, care instructions...) and get a rule-based readiness score 0-100 per product plus the exact missing fields, and an aggregate with the single field that unlocks the most products. INPUT: array of product objects (flexible keys). OUTPUT: per-product score, ready flag, missing field labels; aggregate with top_missing_fields and unlock_hint. Deterministic internal data-completeness rules; not an official textile schema or certification. Up to 200 products per call. No account needed.

products.description: Products to validate. Flexible keys accepted: name/title, sku, description, brand/vendor, composition/material/fabric, country/origin/manufacturing_country, supplier, care/care_instructions, compliance, certifications.

name: validate_dpp_readiness
